subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should every structured `invalid_request_error` that survives the existing specific classifiers advance the configured model fallback chain, including malformed request or tool payload errors?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this intentionally broadens provider/model routing for existing users and the correct product boundary cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Accept broad invalid-request fallback
options.body: Treat the structured type as equivalent to an otherwise status-known HTTP 400 and allow the configured fallback chain to handle every remaining case.

options.title: Narrow the recognized cases
options.body: Fallback only for explicitly recognized replay, schema, or provider-compatibility messages while leaving unrelated invalid requests terminal.

options.title: Pause pending classifier policy
options.body: Hold the PR until a broader provider-error taxonomy defines which client-side request failures should trigger cross-model fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept broad invalid-request fallback
recommendation.body: Treat the structured type as equivalent to an otherwise status-known HTTP 400 and allow the configured fallback chain to handle every remaining case.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows repeated merge and implementation involvement in the shared classifier path, making this the strongest available routing candidate.
